editor.intent: Read the song as one long crescendo through a single four-pass loop: the whole track is repeat_001 at 0.98 similarity, so the level escalates by changing what the player does, not by chasing new material. ARENA teaches during the near-silent first three bars, hands off to RUNNER for section_02's flat, stable groove, hands to VERTICAL for section_03's bass-and-vocal loop, then returns to ARENA for the two genuine climaxes (bars 30-40 and 53-60, where combined_intensity peaks at 0.70). Difficulty reaches 4 only where combined_intensity is above 0.65 and drops to 1-2 whenever the mix falls away (bars 41-46, 61-68).

syncPoints.why: Structural downbeat and song start; ARENA intro begins here on near-silent bars and the first telegraph is placed off this bar.
The first is_build bar (combined_intensity 0.052 to 0.220) and the vocal entry that precedes it - the moment the sparse intro stops being empty, so the first real hazard lands here.
First hook peak (strength 1.0, exact on the phrase_002 boundary) - the BUILD section's opening accent.
Section_02 begins with a -0.129 energy drop and a simultaneous section_boundary; this is the mode switch to RUNNER and the field must be empty at this instant.
The loudest bar of RUNNER's rebuilding half (0.580, is_local_peak ahead of it at 0.695) - the runner's one authored high point before the section peaks again at 21.
Section_03 starts and the mode changes to VERTICAL; the chart's first note spawns off this downbeat.
Hardest drop in section_03 (strength 1.0, -0.330 combined) with is_release true - the VERTICAL chart empties here for two bars before rebuilding.
phrase_006 opens on an energy peak and strong beat (0.657 combined, is_local_peak at the bar before) - the start of ARENA's first peak section.
Strength-1.0 peak at beat 5 of the phrase_006 climax candidate; the densest point of section_03 and the last accent before ARENA's main peak.
Section_04 begins and its first energy_peak (strength 1.0) sits at beat 5 of the same bar - the entry into the song's loudest four bars.
Second structural drop (0.961) with a strong beat; the mode returns to VERTICAL and the field clears on this beat.
0.987-strength peak inside VERTICAL's rebuilding half (0.573 to 0.709) - the chart's densest tap stream is anchored here.
Final-section drop (strength 1.0, -0.334) and the return to ARENA; last peak section begins one bar later.
Last strong chorus peak (0.990, 0.711 combined) before bars 59-60 release - the final ARENA accent.
Vocal stops at beat 2 of this bar and the mix collapses (0.314 to 0.090 combined) - the outro's single most legible event and the hand-off to the final mode.
The only high-priority melody anchor in the outro (strength 1.0); the final note of the level resolves here.

sections.rationale: Bars 1-3 are effectively silence (combined_intensity 0.078, 0.033, 0.052; drums and bass at 0.0002-0.0004), and the first vocal_entry lands at bar 3. Bar 4 is the first is_build flag (+0.168) and bars 5-8 hold at 0.56-0.61 on bass and vocals with onset_density 0.94-1.0. Teach the dodge/graze vocabulary against a sparse field while the track is still nearly empty, and let the first telegraphed hazard land on the bar-4 energy_rise rather than on bar 1.

phrase_002 is labelled peak and bars 9-12 are the first high-intensity plateau of the track: energy_peak anchors on bar 9 and bar 11 (strength 1.0 and 0.998), onset_density pinned at 1.0, and bass, vocals and drums all present. This is the hook, so it is where ARENA first pushes. Keep the same hazard vocabulary as the intro so the escalation reads as louder, not as a new lesson.

section_02 is the flattest stretch in the song (trend stable, mean energy 0.509, onset_density 0.89), which suits an auto-runner that holds speed-feel without needing a climax. The bar_curve opens twice inside it - bar 13 is_release (0.555) and bars 16-18 are a genuine valley (0.413, 0.190, 0.247) - so terrain can open there and rebuild across bars 19-22 (is_build at 19 and 21, energy_peak at bar 20).

section_03's opening phrase is bass and vocal only (bass 0.773, vocals 0.587) over a hard energy_drop plus strong_beat at bar 25 (0.657 to 0.326, -0.330) and an equally hard rebuild at bar 27 (is_build, +0.295). Six-lane call-and-response over the drop at bar 25, then alternating lanes as the bass returns at 27-29, closing on the bar-30 phrase_boundary and energy_peak.

Bars 30-40 contain the song's densest material: bar 35 carries a strength-1.0 energy_peak, and bars 37-40 are the four highest combined_intensity bars in the whole track (0.677, 0.702, 0.667, 0.697) with bar 38 the global maximum and a local peak. This is the ARENA payoff and the only place that justifies difficulty 4 - full telegraph tier, ring gaps and fans at maximum density while drums (0.5-0.62) and vocals (0.65-0.77) are both loud.

Bar 40 starts as a local peak (0.697) but its second half is the energy_drop anchor at beat 5 (strength 0.484), and bars 41-43 fall away to 0.561, 0.608, 0.571 with is_release flags while drums drop from 0.50 to 0.14. Deliberately let go: widely spaced telegraphed hazards, no chains, so the player recovers and the bar-44 drop lands instead of blurring into the peak.

Bars 44-46 are a deep valley with vocals as the only surviving layer (0.471, 0.211, 0.266 combined; drums at 0.037, 0.001, 0.007), then bars 47-52 rebuild to peak on the bar-47 and bar-49 energy_peaks (0.980 and 0.987). A hold-driven chart that rides the near-empty bars as sustained notes and opens into sub-beat tap streams exactly where the bass and drums return.

The final push: bar 53 drops (energy_drop, strength 1.0, -0.334), bar 55 rebuilds (+0.303), and energy_peaks land on bar 56 and bar 58 (0.982, 0.990). Bars 59-60 then release (-0.070, -0.285) and the vocal exits at bar 61. Second ARENA peak, deliberately a notch below the 30-40 one - same hazard vocabulary the player already learned, so the ending is hard but legible.

Bars 61-68 are effectively silence: combined_intensity between 0.033 and 0.090, drums and bass at 0.0002-0.0006, vocal_exit at bar 61 beat 2, and only melody activity (~0.18-0.20) survives. A sparse, slow six-lane chart - one tap or short hold every bar or two, resolving on the bar-68 large_pitch_jump - ends the level without demanding anything.
